children.text: You are currently studying a graph traversal algorithm called the Depth First Search (DFS). However, due to a bug, your algorithm is slightly different from the standard DFS. The following is an algorithm for your Buggy DFS (BDFS), assuming the graph has $$$N$$$ nodes (numbered from $$$1$$$ to $$$N$$$).

BDFS():
    let S be an empty stack
    let FLAG be a boolean array of size N which are all false initially
    let counter be an integer initialized with 0

    push 1 to S

    while S is not empty:
      pop the top element of S into u
      FLAG[u] = true

      for each v neighbour of u in ascending order:
        counter = counter + 1
        if FLAG[v] is false:
          push v to S

    return counter
